population: Five-knot census once per start up to its symmetries; the original uniform seeded sample of 1,000 six-knot census starts.
method: Each drop is a strict decrease between two observed positive birth counts; the start is excluded. A singleton relay requires a drop to one and the full suffix 1,1,2,3,... with at least four observed rounds. T is its first one. The reference alignment pairs T with the actual lone three-place knot's third round. Both readings count anonymous births, preserving multiplicity. Additional columns allow a decrease from the start knot count to the first birth total, or assign round zero or round one if the positive birth totals never decrease.
